verses.text: These were the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
Judah's sons were Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him by a Canaanite woman, the daughter of Shua. Er, Judah's firstborn, was evil in the LORD's eyes, so the LORD put him to death.
Judah's daughter-in-law Tamar gave birth to Perez and Zerah by him. Judah had five sons in all.
Perez's sons were Hezron and Hamul.
Zerah's sons were Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara, five in all.
Carmi's son was Achar, who brought trouble on Israel by stealing things that were set apart for God.
Ethan's son was Azariah.
The sons born to Hezron were Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
Ram was the father of Amminadab. Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, a leader of the people of Judah.
Nahshon was the father of Salma. Salma was the father of Boaz.
Boaz was the father of Obed. Obed was the father of Jesse.
Jesse's firstborn son was Eliab. His second son was Abinadab, his third was Shimea,
his fourth was Nethanel, his fifth was Raddai,
his sixth was Ozem, and his seventh was David.
Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah's three sons were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
Abigail was the mother of Amasa. Amasa's father was Jether the Ishmaelite.
Hezron's son Caleb had children by his wife Azubah and by Jerioth. Azubah's sons were Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, and she gave birth to Hur.
Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri was the father of Bezalel.
Later, when Hezron was sixty years old, he married the daughter of Machir, the father of Gilead. She gave birth to Segub.
Segub was the father of Jair, who ruled twenty-three towns in the land of Gilead.
But Geshur and Aram captured the towns of Jair, along with Kenath and its villages, sixty towns in all. All these people were descendants of Machir, the father of Gilead.
After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, his wife Abijah gave birth to Ashhur, who became the father of Tekoa.
The sons of Jerahmeel, Hezron's firstborn, were Ram his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
Jerahmeel had another wife named Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.
The sons of Ram, Jerahmeel's firstborn, were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
Onam's sons were Shammai and Jada. Shammai's sons were Nadab and Abishur.
Abishur's wife was named Abihail. She gave birth to Ahban and Molid.
Nadab's sons were Seled and Appaim. Seled died without having children.
Appaim's son was Ishi. Ishi's son was Sheshan. Sheshan's son was Ahlai.
The sons of Jada, Shammai's brother, were Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without having children.
Jonathan's sons were Peleth and Zaza. These were Jerahmeel's descendants.
Sheshan had no sons, only daughters. He had an Egyptian servant named Jarha.
Sheshan gave his daughter to his servant Jarha as his wife, and she gave birth to Attai.
Attai was the father of Nathan. Nathan was the father of Zabad.
Zabad was the father of Ephlal. Ephlal was the father of Obed.
Obed was the father of Jehu. Jehu was the father of Azariah.
Azariah was the father of Helez. Helez was the father of Eleasah.
Eleasah was the father of Sismai. Sismai was the father of Shallum.
Shallum was the father of Jekamiah. Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.
The sons of Caleb, Jerahmeel's brother, were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and his son Mareshah, who was the father of Hebron.
Hebron's sons were Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
Shema was the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai.
Shammai's son was Maon. Maon was the father of Beth Zur.
Caleb's concubine Ephah gave birth to Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.
Jahdai's sons were Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
Caleb's concubine Maacah gave birth to Sheber and Tirhanah.
She also gave birth to Shaaph, the father of Madmannah, and to Sheva, the father of Machbena and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Achsah.
These were Caleb's descendants. The sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, were Shobal, the father of Kiriath Jearim,
Salma, the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph, the father of Beth Gader.
The descendants of Shobal, the father of Kiriath Jearim, were Haroeh and half of the Menuhoth people.
The clans of Kiriath Jearim were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. The people of Zorah and Eshtaol came from these clans.
Salma's descendants were the people of Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, half of the Manahathites, and the Zorites.
The clans of scribes who lived at Jabez were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These were the Kenites who came from Hammath, the ancestor of the family of Rechab.
